decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core optical and star-tracker heritage, so it can interpret early mission feedback and improve the product through its own R&D, which makes continuing it low-risk and high-value.

A modular navigation camera builds directly on established optoelectronic know-how and fits the strategic move toward flexible sensors for small satellites, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and develop it further.

Space situational awareness extends the firm's knowledge base into a growing market, and its university and EU research cooperation gives it the capacity to assimilate the new knowledge needed, despite a somewhat higher uncertainty.

The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's rendezvous and docking sensor heritage and matches its compact-instrument strategy; the long space qualification cycles favour keeping it, even though it is so far only mentioned on the website.
